mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz_practical_artifact (context_type, context_id, student_id, question_id, current_version_id, latest_version_no, lock_version, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{contextType}, #{contextId}, #{studentId}, #{questionId}, #{currentVersionId}, #{latestVersionNo}, #{lockVersion}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})

INSERT INTO biz_practical_submission_version (artifact_id, rubric_snapshot_id, version_no, source_answer_id, version_status, score_status, score_snapshot, scoring_details_json, submitted_by_user_id, submit_time, invalidated_time, create_time) VALUES (#{artifactId}, #{rubricSnapshotId}, #{versionNo}, #{sourceAnswerId}, #{versionStatus}, #{scoreStatus}, #{scoreSnapshot}, #{scoringDetailsJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{submittedByUserId}, #{submitTime}, #{invalidatedTime}, #{createTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE biz_practical_submission_version SET version_status = 'SUPERSEDED', score_status = IF(#{scoreSnapshot} IS NULL, 'UNGRADED', 'INVALIDATED'), score_snapshot = #{scoreSnapshot}, scoring_details_json = #{scoringDetailsJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, invalidated_time = #{invalidatedTime} WHERE version_id = #{versionId} AND version_status = 'CURRENT'

UPDATE biz_practical_submission_version SET version_status = 'DELETED', score_status = IF(#{scoreSnapshot} IS NULL, 'UNGRADED', 'INVALIDATED'), score_snapshot = #{scoreSnapshot}, scoring_details_json = #{scoringDetailsJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, invalidated_time = #{invalidatedTime} WHERE version_id = #{versionId} AND version_status = 'CURRENT'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz_practical_attachment (version_id, file_order, file_kind, original_file_name, resource_path, file_extension, mime_type, file_size, sha256, security_status, preview_status, preview_path, preview_retry_count, preview_last_retry_time, preview_error_message, normalized_status, normalized_retry_count, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{versionId}, #{fileOrder}, #{fileKind}, #{originalFileName}, #{resourcePath}, #{fileExtension}, #{mimeType}, #{fileSize}, #{sha256}, #{securityStatus}, #{previewStatus}, #{previewPath}, #{previewRetryCount}, #{previewLastRetryTime}, #{previewErrorMessage}, #{normalizedStatus}, #{normalizedRetryCount}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE biz_practical_attachment SET preview_status = #{previewStatus}, preview_path = #{previewPath}, preview_retry_count = #{previewRetryCount}, preview_last_retry_time = #{previewLastRetryTime}, preview_error_message = #{previewErrorMessage}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE attachment_id = #{attachmentId}

UPDATE biz_practical_attachment SET normalized_status = #{normalizedStatus}, normalized_pages_json = #{normalizedPagesJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, renderer_version = #{rendererVersion}, normalized_retry_count = #{normalizedRetryCount}, normalized_last_retry_time = #{normalizedLastRetryTime}, normalized_error_message = #{normalizedErrorMessage}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE attachment_id = #{attachmentId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM biz_practical_attachment WHERE normalized_retry_count < #{maxRetryCount} AND ( (normalized_status = 'failed' AND COALESCE(normalized_last_retry_time, update_time, create_time) <= #{failedBefore}) OR (normalized_status = 'converting' AND COALESCE(normalized_last_retry_time, update_time, create_time) <= #{stuckBefore}) ) ORDER BY attachment_id ASC LIMIT 200

SELECT attachment.* FROM biz_practical_attachment attachment INNER JOIN biz_student_answer answer ON answer.practical_version_id = attachment.version_id AND attachment.file_order = 0 WHERE attachment.file_kind = 'OFFICE' AND attachment.preview_status IN ('pending', 'converting') AND attachment.normalized_status = 'success' AND attachment.normalized_pages_json IS NOT NULL ORDER BY attachment.attachment_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE biz_practical_attachment SET preview_status = 'pending', preview_path = NULL, preview_error_message = NULL, normalized_status = 'pending', normalized_error_message = NULL, update_time = #{retryTime} WHERE attachment_id = #{attachmentId} AND file_kind = 'OFFICE' AND preview_status IN ('pending', 'converting') AND normalized_status = 'success' AND normalized_pages_json IS NOT NULL

UPDATE biz_practical_attachment SET normalized_status = 'pending', normalized_retry_count = normalized_retry_count + 1, normalized_last_retry_time = #{retryTime}, normalized_error_message = NULL, update_time = #{retryTime} WHERE attachment_id = #{attachmentId} AND normalized_status IN ('failed', 'converting') AND normalized_retry_count < 3
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz_practical_question_material (question_id, material_type, file_order, original_file_name, resource_path, file_extension, mime_type, file_size, sha256, create_by, create_time) VALUES (#{questionId}, #{materialType}, #{fileOrder}, #{originalFileName}, #{resourcePath}, #{fileExtension}, #{mimeType}, #{fileSize}, #{sha256}, #{createBy}, #{createTime})
